summary: Wife of Giovanni Cognetta, born about 1863 at Dasa in Calabria; John's maternal 2nd-great-grandmother according to family records.
bio: Mariarosa Caterina Lamanna was born about 1863 at Dasa in Calabria and married Giovanni Cognetta. Lamanna is a widespread surname in Calabria, with clusters at Melissa, Carpanzano, Tiriolo and Parenti, and it was also present in Dasà in the 1850s, which supports the family's roots there. She should not be confused with a Maria Rosa Lamanna born in 1865 at Casino, now Castelsilano, who married into the Girimonte family. Family records make her John's maternal 2nd-great-grandmother.
sources: Girimonti research p306 (different Maria Rosa Lamanna): https://girimonti.circolocalabrese.org/research/p306.htm
